source: Ragueneau, Caupin and Issenmann (2022), arXiv:2112.09024v3, supplemental tables I and II
selection_before_computation: All non-calibration liquid-state points above 277 K from ordinary-water run 6 and the two highest-deuterium-purity runs 6 and 7. Exclude 293.15 K because it is their calibration anchor. Do not extend IAPWS D2O below its liquid validity range.
comparison: Later Brownian-motion-derived viscosity observations. Their absolute scale is calibrated at 293.15 K using older reference viscosities, so independence concerns temperature dependence, not the absolute calibration. Heavy samples are 96.66 mol-percent D2O, not pure D2O. Use the paper's approximate linear mixture-viscosity rule; no refit.
uncertainty_screen: 1.5% intrinsic relative viscosity uncertainty; add an assumed 0.15 K temperature sensitivity and, for heavy samples, the paper's absolute mole-fraction uncertainty 0.04 in quadrature. These approximate diagnostic bars are not a complete covariance-aware confidence model. Replicate readings share calibration.
